meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 除了自己回答,还能调用本机 Atomic Chat 桌面应用里运行的模型:列出可用模型、把提示发给指定模型并取回它的回复。模型的下载和删除仍在 Atomic Chat 界面里完成。
howto.when: 当你要求「用 atomic chat 回答……」这类本地模型任务时触发;前提是 Atomic Chat 已安装、Local API Server 在 1337 端口开启,MCP server 已注册并重启过服务。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: 先列出模型,再调用生成。

say.text: 列出 atomic chat 里现在可用的模型
用 atomic_chat_generate 让本地模型解释递归
say.note: 模型 ID 需与列表一致。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can list the models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app and send a prompt to a chosen model, returning its reply. Downloading and deleting models still happens in the Atomic Chat UI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to use Atomic Chat for a local-model request; requires Atomic Chat installed with its Local API Server enabled on port 1337, and the MCP server registered and the service restarted.

say_en.text: use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Lists models, then generates a reply.

say_en.text: list the models available in atomic chat
have the local model explain recursion via atomic_chat_generate
say_en.note: Model ID must match the list.
